title: Rules (M5)
brief: Rules screen of goop (/rules): what the Learner agent (ACE-style playbook) learned from your dismiss reasons, saves, applies and chat corrections. A proposed rule is a decision card (plain-English rule, goop's reason with the dismissed offers, the offers it would hide today, keys enter accept, e edit first, x reject); active rules are a one-line list (effect muted on the right, paused muted, the selected one shows its source) with p pause, e edit, x delete. Key hints follow the focus. Status line with the rules focus mode. Below the screen: the chat notice that leads here, the toast with undo after accept and edit in place.

artboards.title: Full screen
artboards.tradeoff: A proposed rule is a decision card that shows its reason and the exact offers it would hide today, above a plain one-line list of active rules with focus-aware key hints; hides the chat and reviews proposals one card at a time
